messages:
maria: Quick heads-up — plan to enable siren-quant-v2 in the model catalog during 2026-04-07 03:00-04:00 UTC change window. Primary asks: confirm fallback order, canary percentages, and rollback signals. TL;DR: canary 5% -> 25% -> 100% with 30m checks. Fallback priority: siren-quant-v1 -> boron-13b-quant -> model-fallback-default. Anyone object? :eyes:

devon: no objections. Do we have capacity reservations in Dedicated for the canary? Also need to pin client SDK mapping for api-version v3.

maria: reservation confirmed — dedicated pool 'siren-canaries' allocated, 4xA1 for initial canary. SDK pin note: add mapping in model-catalog service at /configs/catalog_pins.json.

sara: oncall here — monitoring/checks I'll watch: error rate >2% OR p95 latency +150ms vs baseline -> automatic rollback. Also want a trace flag to force dump on 5xxs.

kai: propose a safety tweak: start at 2% canary for 10m, then 5% 20m, then 25% 30m. If any signal fire, fall back to v1. Less blast radius.

maria: ok to start 2% then 5% then 25% — update checklist below.

maria: Checklist:
```
- change window: 2026-04-07 03:00-04:00 UTC
- canary steps: 2% (10m) -> 5% (20m) -> 25% (30m) -> 100% (gradual 1h)
- fallback order: ["siren-quant-v1","boron-13b-quant","model-fallback-default"]
- rollback signals: error_rate>2% || p95_delta>150ms || increased hallucination rate on eval set
- observability: enable canary trace flag, increment sampling to 20%
- deploybot job: run staged_enable with drain windows and pinfile update
```

deploybot: Scheduled staged enable job created: job_id=job_4790012345_01 — will start at 2026-04-07T03:00:00Z. Steps: allocate canary pool -> route traffic 2% -> wait 10m -> promote. Logs: https://deploy.logs/jobs/job_4790012345_01

devon: added SDK pin PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/model-catalog/pull/482

sara: I'll be on pager for the window. If I see errors I'll post `ROLLBACK` and tag ops.

maria: Runbook link: https://redwood-internal/runbooks/model-enable-siren-quant — follow rollback section if `ROLLBACK` called. :rocket:

kai: thumbs up. I'll prepare quick eval set to run after each step (latency + quality checks).

maria: Last call — unless objections, proceeding. :white_check_mark:

sara: ack :+1:

devon: ack :shipit:
